snippet.title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots | A Dwarf Farm Sim | Official Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
A fresh take on the classic farm sim! 🌱🔨

🚨Live now on Kickstarter! Help us make the game a reality by backing us ➡ https://hammerharvest.com/ks

Play the demo here! 💎⛏ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4519100/Hammer__Harvest_Dwarven_Roots/

Official website: https://hammerharvest.com
Presskit: https://www.hammerharvest.com/presskit

About the game: "The days of dragon-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King sends you to reclaim the ancient halls! Grow crops & magic crystals, mine ores & precious stones, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich and expand a home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress..."

Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots is in development now for Windows/Mac. It is brought to you by the same team behind "Cattails" (2017) and "Cattails: Wildwood Story" (2023), both critically-acclaimed games with "Overwhelmingly Positive" review scores on Steam. Follow us today on Kickstarter to support the campaign and unlock special rewards, and make sure to wishlist & follow our page on Steam!

Credits:
Lead Developer: Tyler Thompson (@FalconDevelops)
Music: Tormod Garvin
Key art illustration: Baban Illustration

Business Inquiries: hammerharvestgame@gmail.com

(c) 2026 Falcon Development LLC. All rights reserved. Gameplay footage shown is from alpha build and subject to change.
